pages.text: The alchemists searched for the $(thing)alkahest$(), a universal solvent that would dissolve anything. It is distilled here from all of Chemistry at once, in the $(item)Alkahest Still$(), in four stages, each with its own boiling point. Purity must reach 95% (a reflux ratio of 5 or more); hotter is faster, but 150 K over the boiling point boils over.

$(fluid)Tincture of Balance$(): ammonium nitrate, nickel-plated iron, sulfuric acid and ammonia - kinetics, equilibrium, acids, heat and current. $(fluid)Tincture of Form$(): a Structure Card, Fine Reagents, a quasicrystal and ethylene - spectra, synthesis, frameworks and chains.

$(fluid)Tincture of Chirality$(): Enantiopure Reagents, a Chemical Clock, tholin and Ammonia Buffer - handedness, time, and Titan. $(fluid)Alkahest$(): a Porphyrin Oxygen Carrier, a Copper Ammine Complex and a Doped Wafer, with the Kekule Ring in the catalyst slot.
Alkahest dissolves any ore: four raw iron, gold or copper and a little Alkahest give twelve ingots. It is $(thing)Chemistry's unifying fluid$(), and one of the five fluids Pleroma is distilled from.
